text:
Nina Torres: quick heads-up  I'm opening a small PR to tidy the Hello-World tutorial: unify env var names, add PS/cmd curl examples, and fix the Dockerfile layering that breaks live-reload. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2512
Ben Liu: Thanks Nina. Can you list the env var migration you'll document? We should avoid breaking examples in other docs.
Nina Torres: Plan is to standardize on REDWOOD_KEY everywhere, and include a one-liner migration table showing common old names (REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_KEY) -> REDWOOD_KEY. Will add a note: if you use an infra integration, search/replace is safe.
Omar Rahman: On the Docker side, the current tutorial copies entire repo before npm install which invalidates layer cache. Suggest this snippet:

```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]
```

This keeps installs cached for most edits. I bench-marked and cold build dropped from 2m10s -> 1m20s.
Ivy Chen: Nice. Can we also add a dev Dockerfile for live-reload with nodemon? Many new users try docker-compose and get confused.
Nina Torres: Good idea. I'll add a short dev-only snippet and label it clearly.
Ben Liu: For the auth examples, please include three minimal examples: curl (POSIX), PowerShell, and Python requests. PS curl needs different quoting so show both.
Nina Torres: Adding those. Examples will use REDWOOD_KEY and x-api-key header. Curl POSIX:

```bash
curl -H "x-api-key: $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

PowerShell curl (Invoke-RestMethod):

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -Method Post -Headers @{"x-api-key" = $env:REDWOOD_KEY} -Body (@{input = "hi"} | ConvertTo-Json)
```

Python requests:

```python
import os
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate",
  headers={"x-api-key": os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KEY")},
  json={"input":"hi"}
)
print(resp.json())
```

Omar Rahman: Looks good. Also suggest a tiny troubleshooting bullet: 401 -> missing/typo env var; 403 -> restrictions on key (model access); 429 -> rate-limited by free tier. Point to Console > API keys for scopes.
Ivy Chen: Could we add a one-paragraph migration note for SDK2/3 users? Many still have old client usage. Something like: what to change in 3 lines.
Nina Torres: I'll add a compact diff:

```diff
- import redwood
- client = redwood.Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
+ from @redwood/inference import Redwood
+ client = Redwood({"apiKey": os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY']})
```

Ben Liu: Please avoid using backtick-style code fences in the in-page summary headings; it interferes with our static site markdown parser in one theme. Use inline code only.
Nina Torres: Good call. I'll remove fenced code from headings.
site-bot: preview build for PR 2512 started. Status will update in thread.
Ivy Chen: I'll run the site preview and check the code blocks render on mobile. Minor CSS gotchas sometimes collapse the PowerShell snippet.
site-bot: preview build passed. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-2512--docs.redwood.ai
Ben Liu: Verified examples render and PowerShell snippet looks fine on iPhone. Tiny wording nit: change "live-reload" section title to "dev hot-reload" to match other docs.
Nina Torres: Done and pushed. Plan: merge after one more quick editorial pass. Thanks all! :rocket:
